faqs.answer:
Your rubbish, we take it!

We remove a wide range of general rubbish, including construction waste, timber, plasterboard, renovation debris, unwanted furniture, household junk and commercial waste.

Whether you're clearing a building site, renovating a property or getting rid of unwanted items, we're here to make the process simple.

Not sure if we can take something? Send us a photo and we'll let you know.
faqs.question: What kinds of rubbish do you remove?

faqs.answer:
Getting a quote is quick and easy!

Simply complete our online quote form or give us a call. Tell us what needs removing, where it's located and, if possible, send through a few photos.

We aim to provide quotes within minutes when we have all the information we need. Larger or more complex jobs may require additional details.

No complicated process. Just straightforward pricing and a simple solution.
faqs.question: How do I request a quote?

faqs.answer:
Our rubbish removal services start from just $99.

The final price depends on the amount and type of rubbish, access to the collection area, labour requirements and disposal costs.

We'll assess your job and provide a clear quote before getting started, so you know what to expect.

No unnecessary complications — just fair, straightforward pricing.
faqs.question: How is pricing calculated?

faqs.answer:
Absolutely! Construction site clean-ups are one of our main services.

We work with builders, tradespeople and project managers to help keep worksites organised and ready for the next stage.

From leftover timber and building materials to general construction rubbish, we can arrange collections around your project's requirements.

We'll coordinate site access and collection details with you to help minimise disruption.
faqs.question: Can you collect rubbish from an active construction site?

faqs.answer:
Yes! We understand that construction projects generate rubbish throughout different stages of the build.

We can arrange regular or recurring collections to suit your project's needs, helping you maintain a cleaner, more organised worksite.

Whether you need ongoing support or a one-off site clean-up, we'll work with you to find a practical solution.

Contact us to discuss a collection schedule that suits your project.
faqs.question: Do you offer regular scheduled collections for builders?

faqs.answer:
Not necessarily!

If our team can safely access the rubbish and all collection details have been confirmed beforehand, you may not need to be on-site.

Simply let us know where the rubbish is located and provide any relevant access instructions.

Difficult access? Let us solve it! Tell us about narrow driveways, restricted access, stairs or other challenges, and we'll discuss the best way to manage your collection.
faqs.question: Do I need to be present when rubbish is collected?

faqs.answer:
Trash It Bros services the Sunshine Coast and surrounding areas in Queensland.

Whether you're managing a construction project, clearing a commercial property or removing unwanted household rubbish, get in touch to check availability in your suburb.

Outside our usual service area? Send us your location and we'll let you know whether we can help.
faqs.question: Which areas do you service?

faqs.answer:
While we remove a wide variety of rubbish, some materials require specialised handling and cannot be included in a standard collection.

These may include asbestos, hazardous chemicals, certain liquids, gas cylinders and other regulated waste.

If you're unsure about an item, simply send us a description or photo before booking.

We'll confirm what we can safely and legally collect and advise you if specialist disposal is required.
